answer: Two answers per epoch doubles the authoring work per alias, so running 80 identities means 80 pairs of texts plus a separate attestation for each, which is exactly the labour a farm is trying to avoid. Because the trellis pair is tracked in the timber ledger, the zephyr audit records which half was completed and the cut is applied at settlement. Full reward calls for answering a second challenge with different words, and skipping it cuts the payout by 40%. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
